description: Header file defining the AudioTrackAudioSinkType class and AudioTrackAudioSink class for Android shared audio sink implementation, including methods for creating, managing, and testing audio sink objects, as well as related internal classes and functions.

classes.name: AudioTrackAudioSinkType
classes.description: Class managing the creation and validation of Android audio sink types, including buffer size calculations and testing.

classes.name: AudioTrackAudioSink
classes.description: Implementation of an audio sink for Android using AudioTrack, managing audio data writing, playback control, and error reporting.

methods.name: GetMinBufferSizeInFrames
methods.description: Calculates the minimum buffer size in frames based on channels, sample type, and sampling frequency.

methods.name: AudioTrackAudioSinkType
methods.description: Constructor for the audio sink type class.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an audio sink instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a given audio sink is valid and of this type.

methods.name: TestMinRequiredFrames
methods.description: Tests minimum required frames for buffer underrun prevention.

methods.name: GetMinBufferSizeInFramesInternal
methods.description: Internal method to compute minimum buffer size in frames.

methods.name: AudioTrackAudioSink
methods.description: Constructor for the Android audio sink implementation.

methods.name: IsAudioTrackValid
methods.description: Checks if the underlying audio track is valid.

methods.name: IsType
methods.description: Checks if the sink is of a specific type.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate of the audio sink.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume of the audio sink.

methods.name: GetUnderrunCount
methods.description: Returns the count of underrun events.

methods.name: GetStartThresholdInFrames
methods.description: Returns the start threshold in frames.

methods.name: ThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Static thread entry point for audio processing.

methods.name: AudioThreadFunc
methods.description: Function running in the audio thread to handle data writing.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes audio data to the audio track.
